## Problem and change

Explain the problem, what changed, and the resulting behaviour.

## Contract

Link the owning specification section and acceptance IDs. State whether this is a local improvement, implementation, or canonical change.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their outcomes. State failures, unavailable checks, and remaining limits. For numerical changes, explain the expected difference and evidence compatibility.

## Operational impact

Describe migrations, deployment, permissions, or public-result changes when applicable. Include external read-back evidence for external changes. Remove this section when it does not apply.
